correctness.rationale: The explicit symmetric density H/(3 alpha) is positive and normalized. Its Perron--Frobenius invariance is verified on all three disjoint half-line regions with v=4-3alpha, |v|<=alpha-1; uniqueness of ACIM is known from the cited 2017 primary paper. Exact branch-preimage integrations give E[Z0Z1]=1/(2alpha), E[Z0Z2]=1-3/(4alpha). Covariance subtracts 4/9, giving threshold 27/20; signed-pair law follows from symmetry, stationarity and geometric impossibility of opposite adjacent signs. Full quantifiers alpha in [5/4,3/2], a.e. boundary conventions and finite-code checks are stated; no finite computation is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The zero-digit frequency is the natural Hamming-weight proxy for signed-binary representations and is identically 2/3 on the entire range. Yet its lag-one correlation stays strictly negative and lag-two correlation changes sign exactly at 27/20. The full 3-by-3 adjacent digit law distinguishes dynamically inequivalent parameters on a flat one-digit plateau; this is a natural complete short-range dependence classification and meaningful boundary, rather than an arbitrary finite sample.
